title: Positive unipotent condensed character class
statement: Use the internal action categories and normalized derived invariants of [def-sfb-condensed-derived-invariants], the actual derived cup unit and regular-unit identifications of [def-sfb-condensed-derived-cup], and the regular scalar map of [def-sfb-condensed-scalar-tensor]. An additive condensed character $a:\underline J\to(R,+)$ is a family $a_S:C(S,J)\to R(S)$ with $a_S(1)=0$, $a_S(gh)=a_S(g)+a_S(h)$, natural for every profinite base change. Group restriction is actual precomposition on every test object; coefficient change is actual composition with the additive section maps of $\varphi$. On the actual biproduct internal module $R\oplus R$, define the unique linear action specified by $j(x,y)=(x+a(j)y,y)$ on every section. The endpoints of its short exact sequence are the actual trivial regular module, its inclusion is the first biproduct inclusion, and its projection is the second projection. Define $[a]:R[-1]\to C_R(J)$ by the canonical short-exact-sequence connecting arrow, applying derived invariants to it after the invariant unit $1$, and shifting down by one with the canonical shift comparisons. The normalization is positive: the section $t(1)=(0,1)$ satisfies $jt(1)-t(1)=(a(j),0)$ on every test object.
